newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Chicago Bridge debuts.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Chicago Bridge debuts.

text.p: Chicago Bridge & Iron Co NV made its New York Stock Exchange debut Thursday with little fanfare in terms of an opening premium, but it one of the most active stocks on the Big Board.
The shares priced at $18, below the estimated range of $19 to $20, and opened flat. The range had been lowered from the $20-$23 stipulated in the filing.
Over 2.3 million shares had changed hands by late morning.

The engineering and construction company's offering, lead-managed by CS First Boston, consisted of 10.5 million shares in all, with 8.4 million slated for the United States and Canada and the rest for other markets. All of the shares were sold by parent company Praxair Inc.
Shares of AHL Services Inc opened with a 1/2 point premium, but the gains were hard won on the back of a price cut. Shares were priced at $10 each, below the $11 to $13 range.
The company, based in Atlanta, Ga., provides contract staffing and management services. It offered 2.5 million shares in a deal managed by Alex Brown & Sons.
Swiss company Logitech International also made its debut on Thursday, and its American Depositary Shares (ADSs) were up 1/2 to 16-1/2 in late morning trading.

The producer of computer peripherals reduced the size of its deal from 2.7 million ADS to two million ADS, with each ADS representing one-10th of Logitech's registered shares. Robertson Stephens & Co was lead underwriter.
